hints.title: Partition Sum Minimum Check
hints.text: If total sum of all elements is less than 2 * k, no partition can have both group sums >= k.

hints.title: Complementary Counting
hints.text: Total possible 2-partitions is 2^n. Subtract partitions where either group has sum strictly less than k.

hints.title: Knapsack DP for Small Sums
hints.text: Count subsets with sum strictly less than k using a bounded 1D knapsack table of size k.

hints.title: Complement Knapsack Counting Implementation

complexity.notes: 1D knapsack table of size k running in O(n * k).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all 2^n partitions takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(k) auxiliary space stores subset sums below k.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses complementary counting with 0/1 knapsack since k <= 1000.
